title: Dead internet theory becomes measurable fact as AI agents flood the web

content_html:
TL;DR

Bots now generate most web traffic as AI agent activity surges nearly 8,000%, upending ad models and analytics built for humans

Bots now outnumber humans on the internet for the first time in the web’s history. Cloudflare, the security firm that sits in front of millions of websites, says automated traffic crossed the 50 percent threshold in June and now accounts for nearly 58 percent of all webpage requests. A separate report from cybersecurity firm HUMAN Security found that traffic from AI agents that actively click links and fill out forms grew nearly 8,000 percent in the past year alone.

The finding is not an outlier. Thales, the French defence and technology group, published its own Bad Bot Report showing bot traffic hit 53 percent in 2025, with 40 percent of all web activity classified as malicious. Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince had predicted in March that the crossover would not arrive until late 2027, but agentic AI programs browsing on behalf of assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini accelerated the shift by more than a year.

The implications run deep for any company built around human visitors. Stripe says 70 percent of the commands used to access its API now come from agents, while API brokerage firm Alpaca reported that agent-driven calls grew from single digits to 30 percent of monthly volume in a single quarter. Cloudflare launched a tool called Precursor this month that watches entire browsing sessions rather than single checkpoints, an acknowledgment that traditional bot detection built around CAPTCHAs can no longer keep pace.

The scale of the shift remains hard to measure precisely because no single provider sees the entire web, and agentic browsers that mimic human behaviour routinely evade detection. A University of Bamberg study found that existing bot-detection systems misfire on real traffic at rates between seven and 15 percent, before accounting for the reverse problem of agents slipping through entirely undetected. Cloudflare, Mozilla, Google, and Microsoft are now developing a privacy-first protocol called PACT to verify traffic legitimacy without tracking users, a sign that the industry recognises its current tools are falling behind.

The web’s business model, built on ad impressions, conversion funnels, and analytics that assume the visitor is a human being, is being tested by a class of traffic it was never designed to handle. Cloudflare has set a September deadline for AI crawlers to pay publishers or be blocked from ad-supported pages, the most aggressive attempt yet to force the emerging machine economy to compensate the humans who create the content it consumes. A PitchBook report estimates that only about one percent of the roughly $20 trillion in work addressable by AI agents is currently flowing through them, suggesting the flood has barely started.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

随着 AI 代理活动激增近 8,000%，机器人现在产生了大部分网络流量，颠覆了为人类构建的广告模型和分析

现在，互联网上的机器人数量在网络历史上首次超过人类。 维护数百万网站的安全公司 Cloudflare 表示，自动化流量在 6 月份突破了 50% 的门槛，目前占所有网页请求的近 58%。 网络安全公司 HUMAN Security 的另一份报告发现，仅去年一年，来自主动点击链接和填写表格的人工智能代理的流量就增长了近 8,000%。

这一发现并非异常值。 法国国防和技术集团泰雷兹 (Thales) 发布了自己的恶意机器人报告，显示机器人流量到 2025 年将达到 53%，其中 40% 的网络活动被归类为恶意活动。 Cloudflare 首席执行官 Matthew Prince 在 3 月份预测，这种交叉要到 2027 年底才会到来，但代表 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 等助手进行浏览的代理人工智能程序将这一转变加速了一年多。

对于任何以人类访客为中心的公司来说，这都会产生深远的影响。 Stripe 表示，现在用于访问其 API 的命令中有 70% 来自代理，而 API 经纪公司 Alpaca 报告称，代理驱动的呼叫量在一个季度内从个位数增长到每月数量的 30%。 Cloudflare 本月推出了一款名为 Precursor 的工具，该工具可以监视整个浏览会话而不是单个检查点，这表明围绕验证码构建的传统机器人检测已无法跟上步伐。

欧盟科技的💜

这种转变的规模仍然难以精确衡量，因为没有任何一个提供商能够看到整个网络，而且模仿人类行为的代理浏览器通常会逃避检测。 班贝格大学的一项研究发现，在考虑代理完全未被检测到的反向问题之前，现有的机器人检测系统对实际流量的误判率在 7% 到 15% 之间。 Cloudflare、Mozilla、谷歌和微软现在正在开发一种名为 PACT 的隐私优先协议，用于在不跟踪用户的情况下验证流量合法性，这表明该行业认识到其当前的工具已经落后。

网络的商业模式建立在广告印象、转化渠道和假设访问者是人类的分析之上，正在接受一类从未设计用于处理的流量的测试。 Cloudflare 设定了 9 月份的最后期限，要求人工智能爬虫向出版商付款，否则将被禁止访问广告支持的页面，这是迄今为止最积极的尝试，旨在迫使新兴机器经济向为其消费内容创建的人类提供补偿。 一份 PitchBook 报告估计，人工智能代理可处理的约 20 万亿美元的工作目前只有约 1% 流经它们，这表明洪水才刚刚开始。
